verdict.rationale: Exa ships its own agent, Exa Agent, as an async web research agent API for delegating list building, enrichment and deep research. Websets lets users hand off a natural-language task in the Dashboard with no code. It then searches, verifies and enriches results on its own. However, the evidence shows no conversational in-product assistant, and hands-on reports show Websets tasks returning many misses and stalling on 'Verifying...'. missing for 10: a documented chat-style assistant embedded in the product UI, evidence of general-purpose task delegation beyond research/list-building, and reliable hands-on task completion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Exa Agent is an async, usage-based web research agent API for high-compute tasks like list building, enrichment, and deep research.
Give it a query like "agtech companies in the US that raised Series A" and it will search, verify each result against your criteria, and enrich every match with additional data you specify.
You can also build websets visually in the Dashboard, no code required.
Each run can return a natural-language answer, schema-validated JSON, field-level grounding, metadata, and a cost breakdown.
